title: Very hard to cancel and company will not retrun any attemt to make contact
text: I got a 6 months, 1 time gift subscription for my sister.  They would not cancel it and charged my account.  They are ignoring me now.  There is no phone number to contact them.  There web page keeps logging me out.  There do not answer emails.  There is no one on the chat that responds either.  Don't buy this product!  Stay away!
label: negative
